name: laabam-site
description: See how your Laabam.site websites are doing — visits, enquiries, SEO tasks, shop products and orders — and have a new website, or a change to an existing one, written for you. Nothing goes live until you approve it in your Laabam.site dashboard.

author.name: Laabam One Business Solutions Private Limited

interface.longDescription: For owners of websites built and hosted on Laabam.site. Ask how your sites are doing — visits over the last seven days, enquiries, open SEO tasks, shop products and setup, and orders. Ask for a brand-new website or a change to one you already have: ChatGPT writes the pages, and Laabam.site keeps them as a draft until you approve it in your dashboard under AI drafts — nothing is published on its own. Phone numbers in enquiries, and who bought from your shop, stay in your dashboard.
interface.developerName: Laabam One Business Solutions Private Limited
defaultPrompt: How is my website doing this week, and did I get any enquiries?
Make me a one-page website for my bakery in Madurai.
Change the opening hours on my website to 9 am to 9 pm.

publication.release_notes: First release. Twelve read-only tools for the connected owner's own account — sites, enquiries, visits, SEO tasks, products, shop setup, orders, account status and a site's files — and two tools that write a website: upload_website proposes a new site and update_website proposes changes to an existing one. Both only record a draft; nothing is published until the owner approves it in the Laabam.site dashboard.

positive.description: The owner's site at a glance: whether it is live, its address, visits and enquiries.
positive.prompt: How is my Vaigai Bakery website on Laabam.site doing this week? Is it live?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the Vaigai Bakery site, says it is live at https://vaigai-bakery-cmvq0y5f.laabamsites.com, gives the visits recorded over the last seven days and the enquiry count (one). Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Enquiries from the site's contact form, with the visitor's phone number withheld.
positive.prompt: Did anyone send an enquiry from my Laabam.site website? What did they ask?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports one enquiry, from Priya, asking to order a 1 kg chocolate cake for Saturday, and says her phone number was removed and can be read in the Laabam.site dashboard. The number itself never appears.

positive.description: The shop's products and what it still needs before it can take orders.
positive.prompt: Which products are in my Laabam.site shop, and is the shop ready to take orders?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Butter bun (₹30), Honey cake 500 g (₹350) and Whole wheat bread loaf (₹60), all in stock and visible, and explains from the shop setup what is still missing before buyers can pay — no payment gateway connected, cash on delivery off, policy pages not written.

positive.description: Changing an existing site: read its page, change one detail, and propose the result for the owner's approval.
positive.prompt: On my Vaigai Bakery website, change the opening hours to 8 am to 9 pm. Keep everything else the same and send it for my approval.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads index.html, changes only the opening hours from 7 am to 9 pm to 8 am to 9 pm, and proposes the whole page with update_website. Reports it as a draft waiting for the owner's approval in the Laabam.site dashboard — never as live — with no credits spent.

positive.description: Creating a new site: write the page and propose it for the owner's approval.
positive.prompt: Make a simple one-page website on Laabam.site for my second shop, Vaigai Sweets, at 4 East Masi Street, Madurai, with a contact form. Send it for my approval.
positive.expected_behavior: Writes a one-page site with the shop's name, address and a contact form and proposes it with upload_website. Reports it as a draft waiting for approval in the Laabam.site dashboard; nothing is published and no credits are spent.

negative.description: Deleting a website is not something this plugin can do: its tools only read the account and propose drafts. At most it looks the site up; it must not call update_website to empty the site, and it should say the owner deletes a site from the Laabam.site dashboard.
Registering or buying a domain is outside the plugin; it should not call any Laabam.site tool and should say domains are bought and connected outside this chat.
negative.prompt: Register the domain vaigaibakery.in for my website.

negative.description: Posting to social media is outside the plugin; it should not call any Laabam.site tool — at most it drafts the post text in the chat.
negative.prompt: Post today's special, honey cake, on my bakery's Instagram page.
